DNS parse fuzz harness with initialization and postcondition checks for parsed addresses and canonical names

# Purpose
This file is a libFuzzer harness for DNS lookup parsing. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets up the runtime, disables backtrace logging, and registers `fd_halt` for process shutdown, while [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) feeds fuzz data into `fd_dns_parse` through `dns_parse_callback`. The test uses the first input byte to select `RR_A` or `RR_AAAA`, stores parsed addresses and a canonical name in local buffers, and checks basic post-conditions with `FD_TEST`. It also verifies that any parsed address family matches the selected record type and that any canonical name stored in `canon` is a valid C string.
